d1e3.d: Additional grayscale and hover effects for figures and images.

d1e10.d: The CSS classes are named using the format {property}{sides}-{breakpoint}-{size} .

d1e17.d: Use extended border utilities to quickly style the border and border-radius of an element.

d1e24.d: Use <whitebox> to hold images and create a whitebox gallery component.

d1e31.d: You can create counters with <counter> and target .

d1e39.d: Extend Bootstrap’s grid system to cover larger gutters, rotations and more.

d1e46.d: Use <slider> to hold cards and create a Slider component.

d1e53.d: Easily make an element as wide (relative to its parent) with using the width="*" parameter.

d1e60.d: Easily set the background of an element to any extension-specific contextual class.

d1e67.d: With <parallax> and the href parameter you can create simple parallax backgrounds. The speed parameter is a number between 0 and 1 that sets the background speed.

d1e74.d: Additional options for the slideshow component for cycling through elements—images or slides of text—like a carousel.
